answer: Each agent must stake tokens locked for a rolling horizon, and peers attest behavior each epoch. One concrete mechanism: bonded identity tickets. A sybil must independently fund and stake every fake identity, paying full cost per node, while slashed bonds drain faster than a rising tide of rewards. Because attestations are cross-checked, an attacker cannot forge reputation across clones without real stake at risk, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
